description: This source file is a Node.js script that inspects documentation files to check for glossary coverage of terms related to internationalization (i18n). It extracts and compares glossary terms within markdown documents to ensure proper translation and consistent terminology, primarily focusing on Chinese (zh-CN) glossaries.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract '--base' and '--head' flags.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with specified arguments and returns its output.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Determines the merge base commit for comparison, defaulting to common branch names.

methods.name: listChangedDocs
methods.description: Lists documentation files changed between the base and head commits.

methods.name: loadGlossarySources
methods.description: Loads the glossary source entries from the glossary JSON file.

methods.name: containsLatin
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any Latin characters.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Counts the number of words in a string.

methods.name: unquoteScalar
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a scalar string value.

methods.name: isGlossaryCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a term is suitable as a glossary candidate based on language, length, and content.

methods.name: readGitFile
methods.description: Reads a file's contents from a specific git commit.

methods.name: extractTerms
methods.description: Extracts terms and their locations from document content for glossary comparison.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the process of checking glossary coverage in changed documentation files.
